ABC informa: Estados Unidos ha logrado su ansiado objetivo de expulsar del país al salvadoreño Kilmar Abrego García, que ha aterrizado sobre las 11 de la mañana de este miércoles en Madrid tras elegir España como destino de su autodeportación. De acuerdo con La Nación (Costa Rica), el salvadoreño viajará a España y después pretende trasladarse a México.
stories.narrEn: The Hill reports: Salvadoran migrant Kilmar Abrego Garcia, whose wrongful deportation became a flashpoint in the debate over President Trump's immigration crackdown, self-deported Tuesday, Sen. Chris Van Hollen (D-Md.) confirmed. Hindustan Times reports: Kilmar Abrego Garcia is set to self-deport to Spain after a prolonged legal battle with the Trump administration. The New York Times reports: Kilmar Armando Abrego Garcia, who was wrongfully deported last year, has left for Spain. NPR reports: Abrego Garcia, a Salvadoran immigrant who became a symbol of Trump's mass deportation campaign, voluntarily left the country on Tuesday after nearly two years of legal battles.

stories.narrEn: According to RFI, the Cop31 climate summit in Turkey has ended in disarray after the European Union and several other countries rejected a proposed global agreement that failed to explicitly mention fossil fuels. According to The Local, the COP31 climate talks headed for a historic defeat Sunday as a final deal collapsed over a fossil fuel impasse and the summit lurched into record overtime in Turkey. The New York Times reports: European and vulnerable nations rejected a proposed agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out coal, oil and gas. According to DW, after two weeks of tough talks, the COP31 climate summit has closed without a consensus on how to quit fossil fuels or fund countries struggling to adapt to a hotter world.

According to The New York Times, the move followed Switzerland’s decision to impose sanctions on an international youth camp in North Korea, which is accused of hosting Ukrainian children for indoctrination. According to Hindustan Times, the dispute follows Switzerland's November 4 decision to sanction the Songdowon International Children's Camp over allegations.
